index_contract: frame_index and parent_frame_index count frames of the derived and parent clips; original_frame_index is the parent's index in the complete downloaded source file. decoded_rgb_sha256 is the resized image; parent_decoded_rgb_sha256 is the parent image it was made from.
resize_rule: Exact area average in integer arithmetic. Source and target sizes must have the same aspect ratio. Each target pixel is the mean of the source RGB values over its footprint, with partly covered source pixels weighted by the covered fraction, computed per channel as an exact integer sum over the common denominator and rounded half up. No colour conversion, sharpening, cropping or padding.
